summary: Fox Corporation filed an 8-K reporting completion on November 6, 2026 of its previously announced acquisition of Roku, Inc. under a June 14, 2026 merger agreement using a two-step reverse triangular structure (Falcon Merger Sub 1 into Roku, then into Falcon Merger Sub 2, renamed Roku, LLC). Concurrently Fox amended and restated its term loan with Morgan Stanley as administrative agent, doubling commitments from $1.0 billion to $2.0 billion and permitting full cash netting. The filing also covers officer departures/appointments and Regulation FD disclosure. Watch integration execution, financing costs and any purchase-price or consideration details disclosed in exhibits.
